## Summary

Running `pnpm --filter @sparkle/docs docs:automation` against the current `main` branch produces a diff in generated API documentation files, indicating the `regenerate-docs` workflow has lagged behind recent package source changes.

## Changed files

- `docs/src/content/docs/api/theme/src.md` — Updated theme package API reference
- `docs/src/content/docs/api/types/src.md` — Updated types package API reference
- `docs/src/content/docs/components/form-input.md` — Updated FormInput component docs
- `docs/src/content/docs/components/form-password.md` — Updated FormPassword component docs

## Context

This is an automated fix from the daily autohealing run (category 3/4: docs drift). The `regenerate-docs` workflow triggers on package source changes, but appears to not have run against the latest sources. This PR syncs the generated documentation.
